PAPER ESTATE / LINEAGE & RETAINED REQUIREMENTS
Keep the useful requirements.
Choose by workflow and source acceptance. Later revisions often cover a different scope. Keep the earlier behavior, evidence and recovery contracts reachable until their disposition is explicit.
Sector Intelligence · three useful layers
R4 supplies the provisional D05 journey, Explore/compare and native Brief/Cycles/Dossier suite. R3 retains Research, saved investigations, Watches and state coverage. R2 preserves the dated 27 September build direction, independent evidence methods and source-version conflict behavior.
R3 records watch states as Produced; R4 marks corresponding write-path bindings as GAP. Preserve both dated records and verify the existing watch owner before claiming implementation. Higher revision numbers do not resolve this disagreement.
R4 · journey & contract · copy URL
https://app.paper.design/file/01M6FAXA774QT1VRDMAG7DFQ2W/p-3-0

Start with Activity & returns. R3 presentation keeps the R2 evidence, catch-up, review and recovery contracts. The September News Desk contains broader ranked-stream, search, brief and correction studies; that scope is not automatically included in the ticker rail.
Source reading, returning to headlines and Mark reviewed are separate actions. Proposed return/recovery controls remain qualified in Build. The full-desk versus rail scope comparison stays open.

PAPER ESTATE / RECOVERY & CLEANUP
Keep history recoverable.
Recovery snapshots, migration records and technical tests live here. Use the Product map and Family index for normal design work.
Preserved does not mean compared.
Both dated Mastermind Pages snapshots remain intact. The 22 October copy has a recorded Commodities fidelity discrepancy; the 8 November copy preserves a later frontier. Neither is a normal build entry or a disposable duplicate.
The migration record below belongs to the earlier migration work. This organization pass verified the directory and current locations; it did not recertify every old/new artboard. The original operation-level migration receipt and exact artboard map still need a located durable reference.

Completed 8 November 2026. Original structure: 144,465 nodes before, 1,046 navigation nodes after. These are native document counts, not storage bytes. No GitHub or release changes were used in this continuation.
Terminal · grouped; physical split pending
Terminal is a separate reorganization: 51 source pages, 521 artboards and 84,529 baseline nodes. Seven Terminal families are planned, plus the existing Macro family.
